evidence: The DMZ was stored in a temperature controlled bubbler and its flow rate (FDMZ) was controlled by altering the bubbler pressure (PB) using a needle valve. The flow rate of DMZ is described by the following equation: FDMZ = FArP/C3 (PB /C0 P/C3) (1) where P/C3 is the DMZ vapor pressure and FAr is the flow rate of the Ar carrier gas that was fixed at 15 standard cubic centimeters per minute (sccm).
